purpose: Define the exact independently approved, create-new one-shot authorization consumed by v7 preflight and its capability-bound child. This template is not itself launch authority.

path_fields.authorization_path: exact absolute canonical path of this external authorization

rules: Parse every JSON with duplicate-key rejection and require exact key sets/cardinalities.
Every supplied path is checked from its original spelling before normalization; every component must be non-symlink and realpath-equal.
Stage, source, and the existing parent of the absent run root are pairwise non-overlapping in both ancestry directions; therefore the run root and result are also disjoint.
Authorization and all audit/runtime evidence paths and their parent directories are outside and not ancestors/descendants of stage, source, or the output existing parent.
Run root and result path are absent; output_existing_parent exists and result_path is exactly run_root/result.json.
Every bound identity and live /proc/self/mountinfo hash/mount ID must match; nested mount transitions below stage/source/run root are rejected.

raw_launcher_path must be the exact canonical preflight_launch.py path; preflight alone issues one inherited Unix SOCK_SEQPACKET capability bound to SO_PEERCRED parent/child PIDs, exact /proc parent cmdline, nonce, authorization, manifest, bootstrap, and scientific-core hashes.

The oracle bootstrap must consume exactly one capability record followed by EOF, acknowledge its canonical hash once, close the channel before third-party import, and descriptor-execute the authenticated scientific core; direct bootstrap/core execution is forbidden.
authorization_nonce is nonempty and the authorization is operationally one-shot because successful output creation makes replay fail closed.
authorization_sha256 is SHA-256 of canonical JSON after removing only authorization_sha256; the outer CLI also supplies the exact file SHA-256.
claim_boundary: The independent approver remains the trust root. No self-authored runtime receipt, audit receipt, copied authorization, alternate mount view, or absent output action is accepted. Privileged concurrent namespace mutation remains outside the cooperative release claim.
